folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B312: connected portfolio and historical proof limits
folds.body:
Both rounds were fully content-reviewed: F1–F6, B1–B5, N1–N4, G1–G14, three pinned mod-source records, P1–P5, U1–U5, V1–V5, X1–X12, arithmetic and R2V1–R2V4. Round2's expanded P1 is the later recommendation for that hypothetical scope; it is not a selected implementation. Keep one connected existing care/work/stock seam rather than create an independent economy for each proposal. Current LOTM-first and selected HP work retain priority.

The useful distinctions are actual available feed versus a future harvest, received cash versus expected sales, stipend coverage versus full solvency, recipe access versus understanding, reserved living participants versus paused biology, and temporary combined use versus transformation. A shared item key does not alone establish exact lot identity, freshness, title, location or reservation. Every relevant view should consume the same actual stock/time/custody facts, including a meal and completion at the same boundary. Neither a forecast nor a ledger creates income or provides a biological scheduler. A cancelled reservation releases the unspent resources it actually held; an already consumed input remains consumed. Private trader beliefs and public terms need not equal hidden quality.

The portfolio can be profitable, powerful or specialized without an invisible balancing penalty. A common supplier can be convenient without compulsory diversity costs; replacement supply and credit work where actual means exist. Care, healing, food inclusion, control and commercial liability need their particular terms. Removing a productive Gu during refinement can remove actual work capacity, but should not invent a lost wage or default demand limit where the authored operation has none. Producer survival, essence-supported output, recipient limits, harvesting, reproduction and rank transition remain separate mechanisms. Learned facts can survive loss of a leased service or sale of a Gu.

Keep numerical statements within their original assumptions. The stipend-only gauge is not a full sustainability verdict. The work-rate table assumes healthy actors, every window used and omitted acquisition/downtime/player-time costs. The0.833 expected input expenditure assumes the same repeatable0.6 chance and0.5 cost;6.67-day payback additionally assumes the stated post-success saving and ignores affordability/delay/other costs. It is not a date guarantee, measured economy, recommended grind, proof that every failure is independent, or reason to nerf the pack. These are old authored prototype dials, not novel prices or current source verification.

N1–N4 remain four bounded keyword-window source checks, with2106 displayed words and explicit overlap, not full chapters/books re-read here. Later-rank relayed profiles keep their own review limits. The19-test result and fourteen-input reuse remain dated focused evidence; no current test was run for this review. B1–B5/G source inspections are not refreshed by copying paths/hashes into a report. The later cross-novel scout corrects documentary-only impressions for previously acquired Factorio, ONI, Cultist Simulator and other references; it does not convert all references into whole-engine reads or prove present installation. Public availability, source family and binary version remain separate.

Donor variety incentives, sockets, victory refills, body topology, source metadata and AI dispatch do not establish Gu laws or all-world simulation. A sustained process needs actual interruption/aftermath and useful output, while current AD51 allows the first useful consumer without a regional simulator or every P row. Current compatibility direction qualifies old unconditional pending-policy retention suggestions. Source-backed broad methods can bypass a proposed bottleneck when their actual mechanisms do. No pack, economy, novel source, private save, external account, install, implementation order or new rule was changed by this content review.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B312: catalog evidence, later follow-through and retained gaps
folds.body:
All323 original lines were content-reviewed: F1–F5, every placement in SA1–SA24, VS2/VS7/VS8/VS9/VS11, OS8–OS11, C1–C3, RN1–RN10 and LB1–LB7. The catalog's33 sections,96 placements and57 unique works are its historical metadata denominator. Repeating a work in independent sections does not imply multiple owned books or source readings. VERIFIED here means the specified metadata/synopsis route was inspected then, sometimes only surfaced in discovery; it is not a primary-scene, native-title, current-link, authenticity or whole-work certification. MEMORY and UNKNOWN qualifiers remain useful rather than being silently promoted.

The empty named Calibre database, historical IDs, ten checked source paths, particular Downloads filenames and NOT LOCAL statuses are October14 observations within the specified stores. They are not present library/account state, machine-wide absence, a user's reading history or an instruction to reimport anything. Later source-library and catalogue owners govern any selected acquisition; this review performs no such lookup, repair, download or reading. The old one-realm/one-prestige condition in F5 is retired under the October24 scope direction. Reading ranks remain proposals, not current world priorities or a live queue.

Preserve what the partial matches teach. A retired expert need not be declining; an elderly person need not be near death. A captive inside a harmful institution is not thereby a willing employee. Ostracism, anticipated harm and an active pursuit have different starting causes. A later collective, other-self revelation or fusion is not evidence of that opening state. A sentient sword, stationary place, host-guiding patron, remote mind and independently acting copy need their own body/control/agency/custody contracts. Two subjects cooperating is not automatically two full lived biographies merged. OS11's missing exact opening two-history merger remains this bounded catalog's genuine gap, not proof no source anywhere can supply it.

The later [disliked-noble lessons](../worlds/START_AS_TRASH_NOBLE_LESSONS_2026-10-14.md) report a completed synthesis over81 supplied units from nine volumes and an original household-start proposal. That later record qualifies LB1's reading-in-progress status for its reported supplied range, without resolving all original occupancy questions or certifying the full series. The later villain/other-selves comparison also supplies dossier-based targeted analysis for several LB entries, so the old no-dedicated-analysis-found wording is historical search scope. Those owners retain their source cutoffs and uncertainty; reading this catalog does not verify their private dossiers or books by association.

In particular, the repeated disliked-noble synopsis supports an expected beating, not an inevitable death. Initial body entry does not settle an original occupant's ultimate fate. Foreign-knowledge, stage, authority, culpability and observers' recognition need their own evidence. Familiar public names, a wiki link or source file size cannot supply missing identity laws. New playable starts should use the selected coherent circumstances and actual first consumer; no exhaustive catalog completion, new source-body reading, absolute ontology or universal test grid is imposed by these source-selection suggestions.
